title: US eMDR rule book (201 rows: manufacturer, importer, user facility)
plain: The blocks FDA requires per report type, as a CSV rule book: manufacturer (M-I, M-F), importer (I-I, I-F) and user facility (U-I, U-F) reports. The manufacturer rows are version 1's, unchanged.

change.reason: B9 step 5: version 1 held the manufacturer rows only. Version 2 adds the importer and user facility rows of the mapping workbook's US sheet (section F, and the shared blocks' I-I, I-F, U-I, U-F needs: FDA's lists, importer 9 blocks, user facility 4, follow-ups F1, F2, F7). The manufacturer rows are byte for byte version 1's. A correction from the start: no report changes.

review.note: Starter, for your consultant to confirm.

approval.note: B9 spec approved 11 Nov 2026 (B9-D10, D11): eMDR rule book version 2 with the importer and user facility rows.
